queue_config.interpretation: Lease window = 90s. Job timeout = 120s in worker arg → MISMATCH: a job running 91-120s is still executing in worker but the queue considers it expired and a second worker may pick it up. CRITICAL for outbox safety: Phase 1 lockForUpdate + dispatched_at NULL guard prevents double-broadcast, so the mismatch yields at-worst ONE duplicate claim attempt that returns silent-skip — NOT a duplication risk in practice.

q7_worker_dies_mid_job.scenario: Worker process killed between Phase 1 (set dispatched_at=now, ++attempts) and Phase 3b (reset dispatched_at on throw).
q7_worker_dies_mid_job.result: Row sticks at dispatched_at=<crash_ts> forever to the eyes of rescue/monitor/retry-failed (all filter on whereNull('dispatched_at')) — SILENT LOSS without HEAL B.4.
q7_worker_dies_mid_job.mitigation_present: HEAL B.4 2026-05-19 added 'crash_recovery' lane in OutboxRescueCommand:42-47: dispatched_at NOT NULL + older than 10 min triggers release. 10-min threshold > 381s worst-case backoff + 30-60s broadcast hang.
q7_worker_dies_mid_job.retry_within_90s_lease: NO — recovery is on a 10-MINUTE rescue lane, not 90s lease. The 90s redis retry_after only governs in-flight jobs without DB-level claim mutation; the outbox uses DB-level idempotency, not queue-level.
q7_worker_dies_mid_job.verdict: SAFE — but recovery latency is 10 min worst case, not 90s. Documented invariant matches code.

q10_redis_down_nf525_break.scenario: Redis dies → Cache::store('redis') ops throw → does FiscalSequenceService::allocate fail?
q10_redis_down_nf525_break.primary_defense: Cache::lock('fiscal_seq_{branch}', 5) — Redis backend, will throw on outage.
q10_redis_down_nf525_break.fallback_defense: DB FOR UPDATE row-level lock (lockForUpdate) inside the same transaction — present in FiscalSequenceService.
q10_redis_down_nf525_break.outcome_if_redis_down: Cache::lock acquisition fails → exception propagates → order creation 5xx → DOES NOT silently allocate gap (fail-safe). NF525 chain remains gap-free.
q10_redis_down_nf525_break.audit_chain_lock_path: AuditLogService Cache::lock('audit_chain_b{n}') has same exposure — Redis down means audit append refuses to proceed → caller 5xx, no silent corruption.
q10_redis_down_nf525_break.production_boot_guard: AppServiceProvider:215 FORBIDS CACHE_DRIVER in ['array','null'] for prod boot. NOTE: 'file' + 'database' drivers PASS the guard — V1.0.X cloud-prep backlog UNI-03 (CLAUDE.md §8 verified 2026-05-21). For V1 LOCAL Le Cayenne single-box, Redis IS the cache driver here.
q10_redis_down_nf525_break.verdict: FAIL-SAFE — Redis outage → 5xx on fiscal-critical ops → no gap, no silent allocation. Recovery: restart Redis → retry. CONFIRMED 'server-state-as-truth' + 'partial-better-than-wrong' principle.

q11_owner_impact_if_outbox_breaks.events_lost_risk: LOW — DB outbox is the SSOT (commit_before_dispatch invariant). Worker death only affects BROADCAST latency, not persistence. Rescue lane B (crash-claimed) closes orphan window.
q11_owner_impact_if_outbox_breaks.sync_broken_risk: MEDIUM — broadcasts feed reactive UI (POS encaisser flash / KDS new-order chip / OSS status flip). Without broadcasts, surfaces still converge within 15-60s via REST polling — visible UX impact but not data loss.
q11_owner_impact_if_outbox_breaks.fiscal_chain_at_risk: NONE — fiscal_sequence + audit_logs + z_reports do NOT route through the outbox. They use Cache::lock + DB FOR UPDATE directly. Outbox is for cross-surface UI sync only.
q11_owner_impact_if_outbox_breaks.verdict: Outbox breakage = degraded UX (POS/KDS/OSS flash, 15-60s catch-up delay) — NOT a fiscal-correctness incident. Owner-impact tier: P1 ops, P3 fiscal.

defenses_in_depth: Atomic claim under lockForUpdate (Phase 1) — prevents double-broadcast under concurrent workers.
Broadcast outside DB transaction — honors commit_before_dispatch invariant.
$tries=6 + [1,5,15,60,300] backoff = 381s retry window — outlasts typical Pusher restart.
PayloadMismatchException short-circuit via this->fail() — saves 5×6000 wasted retries per bad event.
outbox:rescue lane B (crash-claimed > 10min) — closes worker-death orphan window.
outbox:monitor everyMinute → Log::error + non-zero exit if stale_count > 10 — pager signal.
outbox:retry-failed --since=24h hourly — catches attempts>=5 terminal failures.
ws:heartbeat Cache::put on every successful broadcast — observability SoT for admin dashboard.
known_caveats_v1_0_x_backlog: UNI-03 (V1.0.X cloud-prep): AppServiceProvider:215 cache-driver forbidden list = ['array','null'] only. 'file' + 'database' PASS the guard despite block comment saying 'redis or memcached required'. V1 LOCAL single-box uses Redis directly so no current risk; V2 ALB multi-instance needs widening.
FormRequest authz drift (CLAUDE.md §9): sentinel baseline 69, actual count 66 — V1.0.2 backlog to lower the sentinel to ratchet the ceiling.
Worker --tries=3 CLI arg vs Job::$tries=6 — Laravel 9+ honours job-level so this is informational; if version older, worker arg wins.

verdict.rationale: Outbox pipeline is GREEN end-to-end at this instant: queue worker alive, Redis responsive, 0 pending, 0 failed_jobs, 0 last_error. Defenses-in-depth are layered correctly (atomic claim + crash-recovery lane + monitor pager signal + retry-failed + prune). NF525 chain is decoupled from outbox — Redis outage degrades UX (15-60s flash lag via REST poll fallback) but cannot create fiscal gaps. HEAL B.4 (2026-05-19) crash-claimed lane closes the only remaining silent-loss path identified pre-Wave-L. Owner-impact in worst-case outbox outage = P1 ops, P3 fiscal — acceptable for V1 LOCAL.
